checked_sources: M. Damele, Kernel-Wreath Constructions and Infinite Families of Finite Simple Skew Braces, arXiv:2609.20401, full primary text Sections 1-4.
correctness.rationale: The proof reduces first modulo coordinatewise commutators, then analyzes the abelian kernel extension. The exact T-module sequence 0 to K to A^T to T to 0 and Shapiro's H1(T,A^T)=0 give the coinvariant extension by T tensor T; the transgression is the alternating subgroup, canonically the exterior square. Using |T tensor T|=|T| |exterior-square T|^2 gives |G^ab|=|R^ab| |T| |exterior-square T|. The compensation argument also correctly places every coordinate copy of R' in G'. A fresh small-case check for R=T=(C2)^2 gives abelianization order 32, matching 4*4*2; this computation is corroborative, not the proof.
residual_risks: The group-homology transgression is concise in the package; its identification with the alternating tensors was checked algebraically but not against a separate monograph line-by-line.

originality.rationale: The parent paper defines exactly this kernel-wreath group and proves regularity, quotient preservation, iteration and simplicity, but its full text contains no abelianization or exterior-square formula. Fresh Resultary and targeted wreath-product/abelianization searches returned the audited record as the exact hit and no earlier theorem that implies this kernel formula for arbitrary finite abelian target T.

source_inspections.title: Kernel-Wreath Constructions and Infinite Families of Finite Simple Skew Braces

value.rationale: This is an exact natural invariant of a newly introduced group construction. It distinguishes cyclic from noncyclic target steps through a genuine exterior-square correction and controls how multiplicative abelian quotients grow under iteration; it is neither an arbitrary slice nor a table recomputation.

final_claim: For Damele's kernel-wreath group G, the exact abelianization order is |R^ab| times |T| times the order of the exterior square of T; cyclic target steps therefore have no extra exterior-square factor.
limitations: Originality is to the best of the searched literature; an older equivalent homology computation under different notation remains a residual risk.
